description: This file implements an Express middleware for Cognito/JWKS-based authentication. It verifies JWT tokens, extracts user info and tenant ID, and provides fallback mechanisms for local testing without JWKS.

methods.name: fetchJson
methods.description: Fetches JSON data from a URL with in-memory caching for JWKS.

methods.name: getJwks
methods.description: Retrieves JWKS (JSON Web Key Set) from configured URL, using cache.

methods.name: jwkToPem
methods.description: Converts a JWK RSA key to PEM format for verification.

methods.name: getPemForKid
methods.description: Finds the PEM key corresponding to a given key ID (kid) from JWKS.

methods.name: extractToken
methods.description: Extracts Bearer token or id_token from request headers, body, or query.

methods.name: verifyOrDecodeToken
methods.description: Verifies JWT using JWKS or decodes it for local testing fallback.

methods.name: resolveTenantId
methods.description: Determines tenant ID from payload, headers, or environment variable.

methods.name: cognitoAuthMiddleware
methods.description: Express middleware that authenticates requests, attaches user info and tenant ID.
